Taxes Committee
Friday, May 12, 2023
8:30 AM, Room G-3, Capitol

Minutes

Present: Senator Ann H. Rest - Chair, Senator Matt D. Klein - Vice Chair, Senator D.
Scott Dibble, Senator Steve Drazkowski, Senator Grant Hauschild, Senator Jeremy R. Miller,
Senator Bill Weber

Absent: Senator Kari Dziedzic, Senator Carla J. Nelson, Senator Aric Putnam

Senator Ann H. Rest called the meeting to order at 8:36 a.m.

Quorum is Present.
Members Absent but Excused: Senator Dziedzic, Senator Nelson, Senator Putnam
Member Attending Remotely: Senator Miller

S.F. 2920: Senator Weber: Property tax refund program conversion to a refundable income tax
credit.

Senator Weber moved the A1 Amendment. The motion prevailed and the Al Amendment was
adopted.

Testifiers:
Senator Weber
Steve Nasby, City Administrator, City of Windom

Senator Weber moved that SF 2920 be recommended to pass as amended. The motion
prevailed.

SF 2920 was recommended to pass as amended.
S.F. 1949: Senator Klein: Lawful sports betting establishment and appropriation.

Senator Klein moved the A16 Amendment. The motion prevailed and the A16 Amendment was
adopted.

Testifiers:
Senator Klein
Tracie Wilson, Chief Financial Officer, Running Aces Harness Park

Senator Klein moved that SF 1949 be recommended to pass and referred to the Finance
Committee.

SF 1949 was recommended to pass as amended and sent to the Finance Committee.

The meeting v was adjourned at 9:03 a.m.

Senator Ann H. Rest, Chair Christie Blood, Legislative Assistant
